claim: The NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog is an externally curated collection of human genome-wide association studies and association results that includes MS-relevant trait pages and downloadable GWAS resources.
future_grounding_route: Specific GWAS Catalog MS associations can be imported as external-verifiable hypotheses and compared against project-held GWAS/eQTL/colocalization outputs with a documented download hash.
project_use: Competitor/source cataloging and genetics prior-art navigation.
unique_knowledge_lacks_in_repo: Continuously maintained curated association catalog and downloadable GWAS metadata across diseases and traits.
why_unverifiable: The catalog's ongoing curation and full association database are external to this repository and not produced by the project's rerunnable pipeline.
